title: Logo Cap
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Logo Cap |image = Logo Cap.png |source = [[Tailoring]] |ingredients = {{Name|Lava Eel|1}} }} The '''Logo Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be [[Tailoring#Hats|tailored]] using [[Cloth]] and a [[Lava Eel]] at the sewing machine inside [[2 Willow Lane|Emily's house]] or the [[Sewing Machine]] received as a reward for the [[Quests#Rock Rejuvenation|"Rock Rejuvenation"]] special order. It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. Female players have a ≈2% chance to receive the outfit with the Logo Cap. There is a small chance to receive this hat from slaying [[monsters]], breaking [[The_Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]], chopping [[trees]], shaking trees with seeds, digging [[Artifact Spot]]s, or [[Pans|panning]]. ==Notes== * The Logo Cap outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt254.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Sugar Shirt]] and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 249,172,186). ==References== Female players have 48 possible outfits (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". See Utility::getRandomCosmeticItem and Utility::trySpawnRareObject in the game code. Chances are determined in GameLocation::monsterDrop, BreakableContainer::releaseContents, Tree::performToolAction, Tree::shake, GameLocation::digUpArtifactSpot, and Pan::getPanItems. ==History== {{History|1.4|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Fixed description to read "pink" instead of "red". Can now be randomly obtained as part of an outfit from the Desert Festival.
